request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe: Open API Layer for Cardano's dApp Protocols, including expanded protocol onboarding, developer and agent coverage, an MCP server, and a skill framework.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, while the on-chain withdrawal total is 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA administration fee.
Tx3 is described as a framework where each protocol is specified once with a verified interface definition that generates documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live JSON-RPC endpoints.
TxPipe has already put the developer layer into production through Catalyst Fund 14 with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal will fund 12 additional protocol onboardings, scheduled as 3 per quarter, with developer and agent coverage.
The proposal says Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across protocols, causing integrators to relearn protocols and making cross-protocol composability impractical.
The proposal asserts that agent-driven on-chain activity requires shared interfaces where agents express auditable intents while transactions remain deterministic.
The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audit references.
The requested amount is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.

TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect open-source maintenance funding delivered on schedule.

Treasury funds are to be administered through Intersect-managed Sundae Labs smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, multi-party authorization rules, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 project to expand standardized Cardano protocol interfaces, agent-facing infrastructure, and protocol onboarding, with Intersect-administered smart contract controls and several externally checkable governance references.
